description.zh: 《墙》《灵》《根》均由我独立完成，覆盖概念、效果图、平裁与立裁、样版、样衣、Fitting、修版及最终成衣。
description.en: Wall, Spirit and Root were completed independently, spanning concept, illustration, flat cutting and draping, patterns, toile, fitting, revision and final garment.

description.zh: 从3D视觉设计、建模、场景和材质，到动画与最终渲染的完整制作。
description.en: An end-to-end production from 3D visual design, modelling, scene and materials through animation and final rendering.

description.zh: 覆盖导演、编剧、摄影、表演、素材管理、剪辑、调色、特效、配音与声音设计的端到端影片制作。
description.en: End-to-end film production spanning direction, writing, cinematography, performance, media management, editing, grading, effects, voice and sound design.

description.zh: 使用TouchDesigner将声音与3D参数连接，形成实时视听和交互表演系统。
description.en: A real-time audiovisual and performance system connecting sound and 3D parameters in TouchDesigner.

description.zh: 个人作词、作曲、编曲、音乐制作、混音与声音实践。
description.en: Original lyric writing, composition, arrangement, production, mixing and sound practice.

description.zh: 持续进行网页开发、开源项目调研与定制、创意编程和小型工具开发。
description.en: Ongoing web development, open-source research and customisation, creative coding and utility development.

description.zh: 整合Three.js、问卷、AI API、GitHub归档与Vercel部署的自动化3D网页系统。
description.en: An automated 3D web system combining Three.js, surveys, AI APIs, GitHub archiving and Vercel deployment.

description.zh: 创作于Veo 3.1所代表的生成式视频技术阶段，探索AIGC影像的生成能力、限制及其与传统后期流程的结合。
description.en: Created during the generative-video phase represented by Veo 3.1, exploring AIGC capabilities, limitations and integration with conventional post-production.

description.zh: 浙江理工大学服装设计与工程本科、伦敦时装学院Fashion Futures研究生，以及中国服装产业出口隐含碳的数据分析与可视化研究。
description.en: Fashion Design and Engineering at Zhejiang Sci-Tech University, postgraduate Fashion Futures at London College of Fashion, and data analysis and visualisation of embodied carbon in Chinese garment exports.

description.zh: 包括挪威与扎金索斯自驾、杭州至南京五日骑行、ITX与多台电脑组装、家庭服务器、STM32自动浇水、Arduino服装灯光及独立签证申请。
description.en: Includes self-driving in Norway and Zakynthos, a five-day Hangzhou–Nanjing cycle, ITX and multiple PC builds, a home server, STM32 automated watering, Arduino garment lighting and independent visa applications.
